spans.s:
प्राञ्च् प्राञ्च् (प्र-अञ्च्), प्राङ्, प्राची, प्राक्,
turned towards the front, directed forwards, being
before, in front, foremost; turned towards, inclined
towards, disposed, ready, willing (Ved.); turning
eastward, eastern, easterly; previous, prior, former;
प्राञ्चं कृ, to place in front, bring, offer, provide
(Ved.); to promote, further, advance (Ved., Sāy.
= प्रकर्षेण गच्छन्तं कृ); to spread out,
stretch out (Ved.); प्राञ्चस्, m. pl. the people of
the east, eastern people; eastern grammarians;
प्राचि, f. the east; प्राक्, ind. (with abl. or rarely
with gen. or acc.), before (in place or time or order),
[]
in front; up to, as far as (especially in the technical
language of grammatical Sūtras, e. g. प्राक् कडारात्,
up to the word Kaḍāra); in the east; first, at first,
formerly, previously, in the former part (of a book);
at dawn, at day-break, early in the morning; प्राग्
एव, recently, just; (in Buddhist writings) = किम्
उत, how much more? much more, still more;
प्राचा, ind., Ved. forwards, onwards; (Sāy.) = ऋजुना
मार्गेण, by a straight path; प्राचस्, ind., Ved.
from the front.
—प्राक्-कर्मन्, अ, n. preparatory
or preliminary medical treatment; an action done
in a former life.
—प्राक्-कल्प, अस्, m. a former
age or era.
—प्राक्-काल, अस्, m. a former age or
time, a previous time.
—प्राक्कालीन, अस्, आ, अम्,
belonging to former or ancient times, pertaining to
a previous time, anterior, ancient, previous, former.
—प्राक्-कूल, अस्, आ, अम्, having the points turned
towards the east (said of blades of Kuśa grass; ac-
cording to Kullūka on Manu
II. 75

= प्राग्-अग्र);
(अम्), n. the point of a blade of Kuśa grass turned
towards the east; (also written प्राक्-तूल; cf.
प्राचीन-कूल.)
—प्राक्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, done be-
fore; (अम्), n. an action done in a former life.
—प्राक्-केवल, अस्, आ, अम्, manifested from the
first in a distinct form (without preliminary symp-
toms, as a disease).
—प्राक्-चरणा, f. an epithet
of the female organ of generation.
—प्राक्-चिरम्,
ind. before it is too late, in good time.
—प्राक्-
छाय, अम्, n. a shadow's falling eastward.
—प्राक्-
तनय, अस्, m. a former pupil (perhaps a wrong
reading for प्राप्त-नय).
—प्राक्-तूल = प्राक्-
कूल, q. v.
—प्राक्-पद, अम्, n. a preceding word,
the first member of a compound.
—प्राक्-पुण्य-
प्रभव, अस्, आ, अम्, caused by merits accrued in
a former existence, resulting from good works done
in a former state of being.
—प्राक्-पुष्पा, f., see
Vārtt. 1
. to Pāṇ.

.
—प्राक्-फल, अस्, m.
the bread-fruit tree (= पनस).
—प्राक्-फल्गुनी,
f. the eleventh of the lunar mansions (= पूर्व-
फल्गुनी, q. v.).
—प्राक्फल्गुनी-भव, अस्, m.
Bṛhaspati or the planet Jupiter (born when the
moon was in the mansion Prākphalgunī).
—प्राक्-
फाल्गुन or प्राक्फाल्गुनेय, अस्, m. the planet
Jupiter.
—प्राक्-फाल्गुनी = पूर्व-फाल्गुनी, q. v.
—प्राक्-शस्, ind. from the front, from the east.
—प्राक्-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or प्राक्-शिरस or
प्राक्शिरस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, having the head turned
forwards or to the east.
—प्राक्-शृङ्ग-वत्, आन्, m.,
N. of a Ṛṣi.
—प्राक्-श्लिष्ट, a various reading for
प्राश्लिष्ट, q. v.
—प्राक्-संस्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, turned
or directed eastwards.
—प्राक्-सन्ध्या, f. morning
twilight.
—प्राक्-सवन, अम्, n. a morning libation.
—प्राक्-सोम, अस्, आ, अम्, or प्राक्-सौमिक, अस्, ई,
अम्, preceding the Soma sacrifice.
—प्राक्-स्रोतस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, flowing eastward (sometimes wrongly
spelt प्राक्-श्रोतस्).
—प्राग्-अग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having
the tip or point turned forwards or towards the
east (as a blade of grass).
—प्राग्-अपम्, ind. (fr.
प्राक् and अपम् fr. अपाक्), Ved. from the front
towards the back, in a backward direction.
—प्राग्-
अपरायत (˚र-आय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, extending eastward
and westward; [cf. प्राग्-आयत.]
—प्राग्-अभाव,
अस्, m. previous non-existence of anything, antecedent
non-existence or privation, the non-existence of any-
thing which may yet be; non-existence (of an
effect) previous (to production); (in law) the non-
possession of property that may be possessed.
—प्रा-
गभाव-विचार, अस्, m., N. of a Nyāya work.
—प्राग्-अभिहित, अस्, आ, अम्, before-mentioned, pre-
viously mentioned.
—प्राग्-अवस्था, f. a former state,
previous existence.
—प्राग्-आयत, अस्, आ, अम्, extend-
ing towards the east; [cf. प्राग्-अपरायत.]
—प्राग्-
आह्निक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the forenoon (=
पौर्वाह्णिक).
—प्राग्-उक्ति, इस्, f. previous utter-
ance.
—प्राग्-उत्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, north-eastern;
(एण), ind. to the north-east of (with abl.), north-
eastwards.
—प्राग्-उदक्-प्लवन, अस्, आ, अम्, in-
clining towards the north-east, situated in a north-
easterly direction.
—प्राग्-उदङ्मुख, अस्, ई, अम्,
having the face turned to the east or north.
—प्राग्-
उदञ्च्, अङ्, ईची, अक्, north-eastern; (ईची), f., scil.
[]
दिश्, the north-east quarter, the north-east; (अक्),
ind. to the north-east.
—प्राग्-गमन-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, having a forward motion, going forwards.
—प्राग्-
गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going before, preceding, intending to
go before; a precursor.
—प्राग्-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, pos-
sessing the previously mentioned quality.
—प्राग्-ग्रीव,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the neck turned towards the east.
—प्राग्-जन्मन्, अ, n. a former birth, former life.
—प्राग्-जाति, इस्, f. a former birth (= पूर्व-जन्-
मन्).
—प्राग्-ज्योतिष, अम्, n., N. of a city, the
dwelling-place of the demon Naraka; (अस्), m., with or
without राजा, the king of Prāg-jyotiṣa, an epithet
of Bhaga-datta; N. of a country, = काम-रूप;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a people living in the city of Prāg-
jyotiṣa or its environs; (अम्), ind. before day-break (?),
—प्राग्ज्योतिष-ज्येष्ठ, अस्, m. an epithet of
Viṣṇu.
—प्राग्-दक्षिण, अस्, आ, अम्, south-eastern;
(अम्), ind. to the south-east, south-eastwards.
—प्राग्-
दक्षिणाञ्च् (˚ण-अञ्च्), आङ्, आची, आक्, turned to the
south-east, south-eastward.
—प्राग्-दण्ड, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. having the stem or stalk turned towards
the east.
—प्राग्-दिश्, क्, f. ‘the eastern quarter,’ the
east.
—प्राग्-देश, अस्, m. the eastern country,
country of the eastern people; a former or previous
place.
—प्राग्-द्वार्, र्, f. a door on the east side.
—प्राग्-द्वार, अस्, आ, अम्, having doors towards
the east; an epithet of the seven lunar mansions
beginning with Kṛttikā; (ए), ind. in front of or before
the door.
—प्राग्द्वारिक, अस्, ई, अम्, having the
door on the eastern side.
—प्राग्-बोधि, N. of a
mountain.
—प्राग्-भक्त, अम्, n. taking medicine
before a meal.
—प्राग्-भाग, अस्, m. the fore part.
—प्राग्-भार, अस्, m. the top or peak of a moun-
tain; a multitude, heap; bending, inclining, leaning
[cf. प्राचीन-प्˚]; (अस्, आ, अम्), inclined, bent.
—प्राग्-भाव, अस्, m. prior or previous existence;
superiority, excellence; the top of a mountain (in
this sense a various reading for प्राग्-भार).
—प्राग्-
भाव-तस्, ind. from a prior state of existence.
—प्राग्-
रूप, अम्, n. symptom of disease (= पूर्व-रूप).
—प्राग्-वंश, अस्, आ, अम्, having the supporting
beam turned eastwards (Ved.); (अस्), m. the space
before the Vedi, (perhaps) a kind of sacrificial chamber
having columns or beams towards the east and situ-
ated opposite to the Vedi, (according to Malli-nātha
on Raghu-v.
XV. 61

= प्राचीन-स्थूणो यज्ञ-
शाला-विशेषः; according to others, a room in which
the family and friends of the person performing the
sacrifice assemble); a former dynasty or generation; an
epithet of Viṣṇu (?).
—प्राग्-वचन, अम्, n. a for-
mer decision; anything formerly decided or decreed.
—प्राग्-वट, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a city.
—प्राग्-वत्, ind. as before, as previously, as for-
merly, as in former times, as in the preceding part
(of a book).
—प्राग्-वृत्त, अम्, n. former behaviour;
(in law) = प्राङ्-न्याय, q. v.
—प्राग्-वृत्तान्त, अम्,
n. a former event, previous adventure, a story of the past.
—प्राग्-वेष or प्राग्-वेश, अस्, m. a former dress.
—प्राग्-हार, a various reading for प्राग्-भार,
q. v.
—प्राङ्-आयत, an incorrect form for प्राग्-
आयत, q. v.
—प्राङ्-नासिका or प्राङ्-नासिकी, f., see
Scholiast on Pāṇ.

.
—प्राङ्-न्याय, अस्, m.
(in law) a former trial of a cause, the plea of a
former trial, special plea; (अस्, आ, अम्), Ved. turned
forwards or eastwards according to rule.
—प्राङ्न्या-
योत्तर (˚य-उत्˚), अम्, n. the rejoinder of the
defendant that the charge against him has already
been tried.
—प्राङ्-मुख, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having
the face turned forward or towards the east, facing
the east (Manu
II. 51

); inclined towards, desirous
of, wishing.
—प्राचा-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. moving
the tongue forwards (said of Agni; Sāy. = प्राग्-
देश-स्थित-जिह्वा-स्थानीय-ज्वाल).
—प्राचा-मन्-
यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. striving to move forwards (said
of Indra; Sāy. = अप्रतिहत-क्रोध).
—प्राची-
पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the east,’ an epithet of Indra.
—प्राची-मूल, अम्, n. the eastern horizon.

प्राञ्च्; the meaning is ‘worshipping’ when the
nasal is retained throughout (e. g. inst. sing. du.
प्राञ्चा, प्राङ्भ्याम्,
Gram. 176

प्राञ्ज् प्राञ्ज् (प्र-अञ्ज्), cl. 7. P. प्राणक्ति,
प्राञ्जितुम्, प्राङ्क्तुम्, Ved. (?), to adorn, deco-
rate, embellish, beautify.

प्राञ्जन, अम्, n., Ved. paint or cement (on an
arrow).

प्राञ्जल प्राञ्जल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र + अञ्-
जलि?), straight; honest, upright, sincere.
—प्राञ्जल-
ता, f. straightness; honesty.

प्राञ्जलि प्राञ्जलि (प्र-अञ्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, hold-
ing out the open hands slightly hollowed and placed
side by side (as if to hold an offering; a common
mark of respect and salutation, cf. अञ्जलि, कृताञ्-
जलि); joining the palms of the hands in a suppli-
cating manner (Manu
प्राञ्जलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्राञ्जलि.
प्राञ्जलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, = प्राञ्जलि.
